author: OpenCV Contributors (OpenCV.org / OpenCV.ai)
count_basis: VERIFIED by enumeration: GitHub contents API listing of samples/data at ref 4.x returned 94 image files totalling 9,914,974 bytes (14 further non-image files present and ignored).
label_definitions: NO classification labels ship with this corpus. Nothing below is a category label.
VERIFIED by reading the preserved files (transcribed, not inferred):

- stereo_calib.xml: an <imagelist> pairing left01.jpg<->right01.jpg ... left14.jpg<->right04.jpg. This is ground truth establishing that the left*/right* files are STEREO PAIRS of the same calibration board, i.e. distinct samples, NOT duplicates of one another.
- calibration.yml, intrinsics.yml, left_intrinsics.yml: camera intrinsic matrices for the calibration set.
- H1to3p.xml: a 3x3 homography matrix (ground truth for the pic1->pic3 view correspondence).
- aloeGT.png: disparity ground-truth MAP for aloeL.jpg/aloeR.jpg (an image, preserved in raw_images/, not a label file).

- letter-recognition.data: 20,000 rows, each a letter label (A-Z) plus 16 numeric features (the UCI Letter Recognition dataset). Tabular feature data - it does NOT label any image in this corpus and must not be joined to one.
- data01.xml: OpenCV FileNode training data for the ml sample.
- alphabet_36.txt / alphabet_94.txt: character sets for the text samples.

checks.detail: access_method='github_contents_api' requires gated approval or author correspondence that the researcher must complete personally

Mostly not applicable (synthetic renderings, textures, calibration boards, objects, landscapes). Two files depict identifiable real people and are EXCLUDED on consent/provenance grounds - see exclusions.

notes: APPROVED. Apache-2.0 licence text fetched and verified from the repository at ref 4.x. Permits reproduction, modification and redistribution with attribution, and grants an express patent licence - so academic research and ML training are both permitted. CAUTION carried as a condition: Apache-2.0 s.6 grants NO trademark licence, so the logo files (LinuxLogo.jpg, WindowsLogo.jpg, opencv-logo.png, opencv-logo-white.png) may be analysed locally but must not be used in a way that implies endorsement or be redistributed as branding assets.

exclusions.reason: CONSENT / PROVENANCE. lena.jpg is the 1972 Playboy centrefold crop; the depicted person (Lena Soderberg) has publicly stated she does not want the image used, and multiple venues (IEEE, Nature journals) have retired it. lena_tmpl.jpg is a crop of the same work. messi5.jpg is a press photograph of an identifiable living individual whose underlying rights are not conveyed by the repository's Apache-2.0 code licence. All three are excluded even though the surrounding corpus is permissively licensed.

annotation_notes: Directory scan of samples/data. Companion ground-truth and calibration files (homography XML, stereo calibration XML/YAML, camera intrinsics, the letter-recognition labelled dataset) are preserved verbatim; .avi video companions are catalogued but not collected into an image dataset.
